Salesforce capture, 2026-11-09. The namespace case used an authorized Developer org with the synthetic namespace shown in the rows. The unmanaged control used a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org. The Account field-set metadata and anonymous Apex are in project/. Two field sets were deployed for the namespace case; only CodexC163Capture was deployed for the unmanaged control. The same Apex was executed through anonymous Apex at API 62.0 and 67.0. The outcomes transcribe the JSON emitted by System.debug. Both executions compiled and succeeded in each org. Namespace metadata deletion succeeded after capture. Scratch-org deletion succeeded and a subsequent alias lookup returned NamedOrgNotFoundError.
